20261122-physics-m3-2.material: Me ya sa digon ruwan sama da ke faɗowa daga gajimare mai nisan kilomita da dama sama ba ya ci gaba da ƙara gudu har ya isa ƙasa, sai dai ya faɗo da gudu tsayayye (gudun ƙarshe)?

20261118-physics-h1.title: Kusa da fuskar ƙasa
20261118-physics-h1.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin Kusa da fuskar ƙasa don warware matsalar bincike.
20261118-physics-h1.material: Kusa da fuskar ƙasa, daga cikin ƙwallayen ƙarfe biyu A da B a tsayi ɗaya, an sake A daga tsaye ta faɗo da yardar kanta, an harba B da ƙarfi a kwance. Wane bayani ne daidai game da motsinsu? (A yi watsi da juriyar iska.)
20261118-physics-h1.s.s1.prompt: Kusa da fuskar ƙasa, daga cikin ƙwallayen ƙarfe biyu A da B a tsayi ɗaya, an sake A daga tsaye ta faɗo da yardar kanta, an harba B da ƙarfi a kwance. Wane bayani ne daidai game da motsinsu? (A yi watsi da juriyar iska.)

20261119-physics-h1.title: ɗaya a kan simintin ƙasa
20261119-physics-h1.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin ɗaya a kan simintin ƙasa don warware matsalar bincike.
20261119-physics-h1.material: An jefa ƙwai biyu masu nauyi ɗaya daga tsayi ɗaya, ɗaya a kan simintin ƙasa, ɗayan a kan matashi mai laushi. Wane kwatancen adadin kimiyya ne daidai, daga lokacin da kowane ƙwai ya taɓa saman har ya tsaya?
20261119-physics-h1.s.s1.prompt: An jefa ƙwai biyu masu nauyi ɗaya daga tsayi ɗaya, ɗaya a kan simintin ƙasa, ɗayan a kan matashi mai laushi. Wane kwatancen adadin kimiyya ne daidai, daga lokacin da kowane ƙwai ya taɓa saman har ya tsaya?
20261119-physics-h1.s.s1.explain: Tun da canjin motsin (momentum) ƙwai biyun ($\Delta p$) iri ɗaya ne, impulse ($I = F\Delta t$) iri ɗaya ne. Matashi yana tsawaita lokacin karo $\Delta t$, yana rage matsakaicin ƙarfin bugu $F = \frac{I}{\Delta t}$, don haka ƙwan ba ya fashewa.
20261119-physics-h1.s.s1.hint.0: Tun da sun faɗo daga tsayi ɗaya, gudu kafin karo da canjin gudu zuwa tsayawa (canjin motsi = impulse) iri ɗaya ne.
20261119-physics-h1.s.s1.hint.1: Matashi mai laushi yana matsewa kuma yana tsawaita lokacin karo (Δt).
20261119-physics-h1.s.s1.o.o0: Girman motsin tura (impulse) iri ɗaya ne, amma matsakaicin ƙarfin da ƙwan kan matashi ke samu ya fi ƙanƙanta

20261119-physics-h1.s.s1.o.o3: Matsakaicin ƙarfin bugun da ƙwai biyun ke samu iri ɗaya ne

20261121-physics-h1-1.material: Wata ƙwallon baseball mai nauyin kilogiram 0.5 tana tafe da gudun mita 30 a daƙiƙa sai sandar bugu ta bugi ta, ta koma kishiyar hanya da gudun mita 40 a daƙiƙa. Nawa ne girman impulse da ƙwallon ta samu?

20261121-physics-h1-1.s.s1.prompt: Wata ƙwallon baseball mai nauyin kilogiram 0.5 tana tafe da gudun mita 30 a daƙiƙa sai sandar bugu ta bugi ta, ta koma kishiyar hanya da gudun mita 40 a daƙiƙa. Nawa ne girman impulse da ƙwallon ta samu?

20261122-physics-h1-1.title: Zurfafa injiniyanci
20261122-physics-h1-1.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin Zurfafa injiniyanci don warware matsalar bincike.
20261122-physics-h1-1.material: [Zurfafa injiniyanci] An harba wani abu mai nauyin kilogiram 1 a kwance da gudun mita 20 a daƙiƙa daga gefen dutse mai tsayin mita 80. Nawa ne nisan da ya yi a kwance kafin ya isa ƙasa? (A yi amfani da g = 10 m/s² kuma a yi watsi da juriyar iska.)
20261122-physics-h1-1.s.s1.prompt: [Zurfafa injiniyanci] An harba wani abu mai nauyin kilogiram 1 a kwance da gudun mita 20 a daƙiƙa daga gefen dutse mai tsayin mita 80. Nawa ne nisan da ya yi a kwance kafin ya isa ƙasa? (A yi amfani da g = 10 m/s² kuma a yi watsi da juriyar iska.)
20261122-physics-h1-1.s.s1.explain: Lokacin faɗuwa a tsaye shi ne $80 = \frac{1}{2} \times 10 \times t^2 \implies t^2 = 16 \implies t = 4$ daƙiƙa. Tun da motsin a kwance tsayayye ne, nisan a kwance shi ne $x = v_x t = 20\text{ m/s} \times 4\text{ s} = 80\text{ m}$.
20261122-physics-h1-1.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko a nemo lokacin faɗuwa t: h = (1/2) g t² → 80 = (1/2) × 10 × t²
20261122-physics-h1-1.s.s1.hint.1: Sa'an nan a lissafa nisan a kwance x = v_x × t.

20261122-physics-h1-2.title: Menene dalilin kimiyya da ya sa allunan
20261122-physics-h1-2.topic: Menene dalilin kimiyya da ya sa allunan
20261122-physics-h1-2.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin Menene dalilin kimiyya da ya sa allunan don warware matsalar bincike.
20261122-physics-h1-2.material: Menene dalilin kimiyya da ya sa allunan OLED (organic light-emitting diode) da ake amfani da su a sababbin wayoyin hannu da talabijin suka fi na LCD na da sirara kuma suna da bambancin haske da duhu mafi kyau?
20261122-physics-h1-2.thinking.0: Menene dalilin kimiyya da ya sa allunan
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.prompt: Menene dalilin kimiyya da ya sa allunan OLED (organic light-emitting diode) da ake amfani da su a sababbin wayoyin hannu da talabijin suka fi na LCD na da sirara kuma suna da bambancin haske da duhu mafi kyau?
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.explain: OLED yana amfani da siraran yadudduka na organic semiconductor da ke fitar da haske da kansu idan wuta ta ratsa su, don haka ba a buƙatar backlight mai kauri, kuma ta kashe pixels yana samun baƙi cikakke, yana ba da bambancin haske marar iyaka.
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.hint.0: LCD yana buƙatar backlight da ke haskaka haske daga baya.
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.hint.1: A OLED, kowanne pixel yana fitar da haske da kansa.
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.o.o0: Saboda suna amfani da abubuwan sinadarin organic masu fitar da haske da kansu ba tare da wani backlight daban ba
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.o.o1: Saboda OLED ruwa ne da ba ya amfani da wutar lantarki ko kaɗan
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.o.o2: Saboda dubban ƙananan fitilun fluorescent suna cikin OLED
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.o.o3: Saboda suna amfani da faranti na ƙarfe maimakon gilashi
